spec: Tasks (sim/tasks): what people are working on, derived each day from build plans, civic sites, facility crews, road crews, stuck wagons and the household pot. The player helps by holding E at a task's work spot (interact/hold.ts): one hold of holdMs is one effort unit. Effort goes to the real thing (a plan's labour, a road's condition, a wagon's wheel) or, for sites, facilities and the pot, waits as a bonus applied at the next dawn. Rewards replace the old work_alongside verb (sparkGain 4, flame +0.04, despair -0.01) spread over effort, and spark stays scarce: sparkPerDay caps it across every task.
done: You put your back into it beside {name}.
You work a while with {name}. It goes quicker with two.
You take a turn {verb}; {name} nods and keeps on.
doneNobody: You put your back into it.
thanks: That's a help. It goes quicker with you.
Good hands. We'll have it done sooner.
I didn't ask, but I'm glad of it.
Stay as long as you like. There's plenty of it.
wheelFree: The wheel lurches out of the rut. The driver whistles thanks and tosses you a coin.
enough: {name} waves you off: "That's plenty for today. Come back tomorrow."
enoughNobody: Your hands have done what they can here today.
gone: There's nothing to help with here now.
dawn: {name} says {goal} went quicker yesterday for your hands.
{name} is telling people you turned up and worked {verb} without being asked.
